entry: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Samurott
entry: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

name: Patrat
entry: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

name: Watchog
entry: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

name: Lillipup
entry: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

name: Herdier
entry: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

name: Stoutland
entry: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

name: Purrloin
entry: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
entry: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

name: Pansage
entry: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

name: Simisage
entry: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Pansear
entry: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

name: Simisear
entry: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Panpour
entry: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

name: Simipour
entry: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

name: Munna
entry: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dreams, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Musharna
entry: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

name: Pidove
entry: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Tranquill
entry: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

name: Unfezant
entry: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

name: Blitzle
entry: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
entry: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Roggenrola
entry: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

name: Boldore
entry: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
entry: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

name: Woobat
entry: Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

name: Swoobat
entry: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

name: Drilbur
entry: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
entry: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

name: Audino
entry: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

name: Timburr
entry: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

name: Gurdurr
entry: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

name: Conkeldurr
entry: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

name: Tympole
entry: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
entry: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Seismitoad
entry: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Throh
entry: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

name: Sawk
entry: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Sewaddle
entry: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
entry: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Leavanny
entry: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Venipede
entry: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggresive.

name: Whirlipede
entry: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Scolipede
entry: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponents and poison them.

name: Cottonee
entry: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

name: Whimsicott
entry: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

name: Petilil
entry: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Lilligant
entry: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

name: Basculin
entry: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's schooL.

name: Sandile
entry: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Krokorok
entry: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings, even in darkness.

name: Krookodile
entry: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

name: Darumaka
entry: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

name: Darmanitan
entry: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

name: Maractus
entry: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Dwebble
entry: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

name: Crustle
entry: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.

name: Scraggy
entry: It immediately headbutts anyone that makes eye contact with it. Its skull is massively thick.

name: Scrafty
entry: It can smash concrete blocks with its kicking attacks. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader.

name: Sigilyph
entry: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Yamask
entry: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Cofagrigus
entry: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Tirtouga
entry: About 100 million years ago, these Pokémon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.

name: Carracosta
entry: Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

name: Archen
entry: Revived from a fossil, this Pokémon is thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon.

name: Archeops
entry: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.

name: Trubbish
entry: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that crated this Pokémon.

name: Garbodor
entry: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

name: Zorua
entry: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

name: Zoroark
entry: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

name: Minccino
entry: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
entry: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Gothita
entry: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothorita
entry: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
entry: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

name: Solosis
entry: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

name: Duosion
entry: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

name: Reuniclus
entry: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: Ducklett
entry: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
entry: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

name: Vanillite
entry: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

name: Vanillish
entry: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

name: Vanilluxe
entry: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

name: Deerling
entry: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
entry: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

name: Emolga
entry: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Karrablast
entry: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

name: Escavalier
entry: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Foongus
entry: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

name: Amoonguss
entry: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Frillish
entry: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

name: Jellicent
entry: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. Their favorite food is life energy.

name: Alomomola
entry: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Joltik
entry: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
entry: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Ferroseed
entry: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

name: Ferrothorn
entry: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Klink
entry: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Klang
entry: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

name: Klinklang
entry: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Tynamo
entry: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

name: Eelektrik
entry: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
entry: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

name: Elgyem
entry: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Beheeyem
entry: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

name: Litwick
entry: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
entry: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Chandelure
entry: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Axew
entry: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Fraxure
entry: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Haxorus
entry: Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams. These Pokémon are covered in hard armor.

name: Cubchoo
entry: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
entry: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

name: Cryogonal
entry: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Shelmet
entry: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

name: Accelgor
entry: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Stunfisk
entry: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of energy.

name: Mienfoo
entry: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise.

name: Mienshao
entry: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents.

name: Druddigon
entry: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. Then skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Golett
entry: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

name: Golurk
entry: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Pawniard
entry: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

name: Bisharp
entry: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Bouffalant
entry: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. They headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

name: Rufflet
entry: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Braviary
entry: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

name: Vullaby
entry: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

name: Mandibuzz
entry: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

name: Heatmor
entry: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Durant
entry: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels in mazes.

name: Deino
entry: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
entry: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

name: Hydreigon
entry: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Larvesta
entry: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
entry: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

name: Cobalion
entry: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Terrakion
entry: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Virizion
entry: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Tornadus
entry: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Thundurus
entry: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Reshiram
entry: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Zekrom
entry: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Landorus
entry: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

name: Kyurem
entry: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Keldeo
entry: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Meloetta
entry: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

name: Genesect
entry: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
